purpose: Classify parity drift dimensions before candidate promotion gates can make MT5/FTMO decisions.

dimensions.description: Order lifecycle state mismatch, including missing open, pending placement/removal, close, hard exit, SL/TP, or cancellation events.
Signal, order placement, fill, exit, session-boundary, or daily-reset timestamp drift.
Entry/exit price, partial-fill, pending-trigger, rejection, or retcode behavior drift.
Spread, commission, swap, slippage, or execution-cost drift between research and MT5 evidence.
Mismatch in number of opened, closed, skipped, rejected, or duplicated trades.
Balance/equity drawdown drift, including intratrade equity paths when FTMO rules are in scope.
FTMO rule-accounting drift, including daily loss, maximum loss, trailing high-watermark, floating P/L, commissions, swaps, and reset-time treatment.

rules: Promotion-grade parity reports must classify all dimensions.
Promotion-grade parity reports must cite empirical threshold sources for every thresholded dimension.
Missing empirical thresholds block parity promotion instead of silently guessing.
Signal-only parity cannot satisfy lifecycle, fill, cost, drawdown, rule-accounting, MT5 tester, FTMO forward, or deployable gates.
